messages.content: You look at one picture with no other context and describe exactly what is drawn, like a careful field naturalist. Do not guess what was intended; describe only what is visible. description: a free paragraph describing the whole creature first. parts: every body part you see, one entry each (head, horns, ears, mane, legs, feet, tail, wings, gills, tentacles, shell, plates, scales, feathers, markings), with what it looks like and where it is. attached_objects: anything that looks attached to or sitting on the body rather than part of it, such as an object, an armor piece or a whole small animal; empty if none. animals: every real animal whose features you can see, as everyday English common names, at most four; include any animal that only one part resembles. Then count, looking carefully: separate_bodies: separate animal bodies or body-shaped objects in the picture, including any whole animal or animal-shaped object attached to or sitting on the main creature. heads: heads of any kind. walking_legs: legs the creature stands or walks on, including hidden ones you can infer. wings: wings of any kind. extra_limb_pieces: jointed leg-like, claw-like or tentacle-like pieces other than the walking legs and the tail. tails: tails of any kind (0 if none).

message.content: { "description": "The creature is a quadrupedal, bear-bodied animal shown in right-facing profile against a plain light background. Its head, neck, lower legs, paws and short rear tuft are covered in dense brown fur with a lighter tan muzzle, while its back, shoulders, sides, hips and most of each leg are covered by a glossy, dark brown to black segmented exoskeleton that looks like beetle armor. A single long, smooth, black horn curves up and back from the center of the forehead. The dorsal armor consists of overlapping transverse plates from the neck to the rump, large shoulder and hip shields, and plated greaves on the legs; the flanks and belly show lighter tan, ribbed plates with two longitudinal rows of oval openings. The animal stands on four broad paws with visible claws.", "parts": [ { "part": "head", "looks_like": "bear-like with dense brown fur, a paler tan muzzle, a large black nose at the tip of the snout, small dark brown eyes on the sides, and a closed mouth", "where": "at the front end of the body, facing to the right" }, { "part": "horns", "looks_like": "one long, glossy black, smooth horn that tapers to a sharp point, curving strongly upward and backward from the forehead then forward at the tip, with a small thorn-like projection on the inner curve", "where": "arising from the midline of the forehead between the ears and arching over the head" }, { "part": "ears", "looks_like": "two small, rounded, brown furry ears with slightly darker edges", "where": "on top of the head, one on each side of the base of the horn" }, { "part": "legs", "looks_like": "four thick, stout legs, each with upper and middle sections encased in overlapping glossy dark segmented plates and with brown fur visible at the joints and around the lower leg", "where": "two forelegs under the chest and two hindlegs under the hips, supporting the body" }, { "part": "feet", "looks_like": "four broad bear paws with brown fur and five long, curved, light-tipped claws on each", "where": "at the bottom of each leg, in contact with the ground" }, { "part": "tail", "looks_like": "a short tuft of shaggy brown fur", "where": "at the extreme rear of the body, protruding from under the rear dorsal plates on the left side of the image" }, { "part": "plates", "looks_like": "extensive glossy dark brown to black chitinous armor made of overlapping transverse dorsal plates, large smooth shoulder and hip shields with pointed lower edges, and segmented greaves on the legs;
